Practical answers

Frequently asked questions about supermarket POS systems.

Which till suits my supermarket or food shop?

This depends on your range, number of workstations, sales by weight and management information needs. KassaKompas helps you compare an affordable starter till and a comprehensive professional setup. Test a familiar sale with your own products.

Can I connect scales to the till?

We review which scales and POS software suit your sales by weight. The specific equipment, data exchange and usage requirements are checked beforehand. Scales are not automatically included with every till.

Can I scan products and use labels?

We assess this for your product codes, scanner and any labelling solution. For weighed products, we also check how codes and weighing data are processed. The chosen software and equipment determine what is possible.

Can invoicing connect to my accounting?

A suitable invoicing or accounting integration can support sales data transfer. We check your accounting package and POS software and agree which data is exchanged and how it is processed.

Does the till work with automatic cash handling?

This depends on the cash handling module and POS software. We discuss positioning, operation and payment processing and check the combination before proposing a cash handling device.

Can I manage several tills or sales points?

We discuss which data you want to manage centrally, such as products, prices and reports. We then review data exchange between workstations or locations and the modules required.

What does a supermarket POS system cost?

Costs depend on the number of workstations, scanners, scales, software modules and integrations. Request a proposal separating one-off and recurring costs, with clear installation and support arrangements.
